CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ProductSpec] AS 
SELECT 
    p.product_id, 
    p.product_name, 
    p.thumbnail, 
    p.purpose, 
    p.series_id, 
    ps.series_name, 
    b.brand_id, 
    b.brand_name, 
    c.category_id, 
    c.category_name, 
    MIN(ISNULL(fs_active.sale_price, pv.selling_price)) AS min_price, 
    MIN(pv.selling_price) AS original_price, 
    CASE WHEN MIN(pv.selling_price) > 0 THEN CAST(ROUND((MIN(pv.selling_price) - MIN(ISNULL(fs_active.sale_price, pv.selling_price))) * 100.0 / MIN(pv.selling_price), 0) AS INT) ELSE 0 END AS discount_percent, 
    ISNULL(SUM(sales.sold_quantity), 0) AS sold_quantity, 
    MAX(specs.cpu) AS cpu, 
    MAX(specs.ram) AS ram, 
    MAX(specs.ssd) AS ssd, 
    MAX(specs.gpu) AS gpu, 
    MAX(specs.screen) AS screen, 
    MAX(specs.connectivity) AS connectivity, 
    MAX(specs.switch_type) AS switch_type, 
    MAX(specs.dpi) AS dpi 
FROM Product p 
JOIN Brand b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id 
JOIN Category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id 
JOIN ProductVariant pv ON p.product_id = pv.product_id 
LEFT JOIN ProductSeries ps ON p.series_id = ps.series_id 
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        variant_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN specification_id = 1  THEN value END) AS cpu, 
        MAX(CASE WHEN specification_id = 2  THEN value END) AS ram, 
        MAX(CASE WHEN specification_id = 5  THEN value END) AS ssd, 
        MAX(CASE WHEN specification_id = 4  THEN value END) AS gpu, 
        MAX(CASE WHEN specification_id = 3  THEN value END) AS screen, 
        MAX(CASE WHEN specification_id = 18 THEN value END) AS connectivity, 
        MAX(CASE WHEN specification_id = 10 THEN value END) AS switch_type, 
        MAX(CASE WHEN specification_id = 13 THEN value END) AS dpi 
    FROM VariantSpecification
    GROUP BY variant_id
) specs ON pv.variant_id = specs.variant_id 
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS sold_quantity
    FROM OrderDetail
    GROUP BY variant_id
) sales ON pv.variant_id = sales.variant_id 
LEFT JOIN ( 
    SELECT fsi.variant_id, MIN(fsi.sale_price) AS sale_price 
    FROM FlashSaleItem fsi 
    JOIN FlashSale fs ON fsi.flashsale_id = fs.flashsale_id 
    WHERE GETDATE() >= fs.start_time AND GETDATE() <= fs.end_time 
    GROUP BY fsi.variant_id 
) fs_active ON pv.variant_id = fs_active.variant_id 
GROUP BY 
    p.product_id, p.product_name, p.thumbnail, p.purpose, 
    p.series_id, ps.series_name, 
    b.brand_id, b.brand_name, 
    c.category_id, c.category_name;
